# adlc_group (Data Source)

Reads an existing Active Directory group. Use it to reference groups that are not managed by this Terraform configuration, for example to obtain a `sid` for an access rule or a GPO security filter.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing group that Terraform does not manage, for example a built-in or
# a group created by another team.
data "adlc_group" "help_desk" {
  identity = "Help Desk"
}

# Use its SID where a security principal is expected.
resource "adlc_access_rule" "help_desk_reset_passwords" {
  target                = "Contoso/Staff"
  trustee               = data.adlc_group.help_desk.sid
  rights                = ["ExtendedRight"]
  object_type           = "Reset Password"
  inheritance           = "Descendents"
  inherited_object_type = "user"
}

output "help_desk" {
  value = {
    distinguished_name = data.adlc_group.help_desk.distinguished_name
    sid                = data.adlc_group.help_desk.sid
    scope              = data.adlc_group.help_desk.scope
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Identity of the group to look up. Accepts a distinguished name, `objectGUID`, SID, `DOMAIN\name` or `sAMAccountName`. Reading fails if no group matches.

### Read-Only

- `category` (String) Group category: `Security` or `Distribution`.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `display_name` (String) Display name (`displayName`).
- `distinguished_name` (String) Distinguished name of the group.
- `homepage` (String) Web page address (`wWWHomePage`).
- `id` (String) Account `objectGUID`, stable across renames and moves.
- `info` (String) Notes (`info`).
- `mail` (String) Email address (`mail`).
- `managed_by` (String) Distinguished name of the group's owner (`managedBy`).
- `name` (String) Group name (the `CN`).
- `path` (String) Slash-delimited path of the container holding the group, relative to the domain root.
- `sam_account_name` (String) Pre-Windows 2000 group name.
- `scope` (String) Group scope: `DomainLocal`, `Global` or `Universal`.
- `sid` (String) Security identifier of the group.
